verdict.rationale: The founder describes Zero as an email client that 'auto-categorizes' the inbox, which is the product's own capability toward splitting mail into streams. However, no documentation describes specific streams or priority-ordered triage views; the label creation and label filtering tools are MCP building blocks, not a split-inbox feature. Missing for 10: documented split-inbox streams (important, team, newsletters, calendar invites), priority-ordered triage views, first-party docs describing the categorization behavior, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
